name: publish-page

# 你改了 index.html（push 到 main）就自动同步到网页，不用重新抓数据
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'index.html'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: site-publish
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  page:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: code
      - run: bash code/scripts/site.sh page
